figurative_meaning_en: One who can perceive or understand deeply
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চোখাবুদ্ধি দেখে সবাই অবাক হয়ে গেল।
চোখাবুদ্ধি থাকলে সমস্যা সহজেই সমাধান হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone was amazed by his sharp perception.
With keen insight, problems are easily solved.
note: Refers to intuitive understanding in Bengali linguistic tradition
